semantics.basis: Recorded M3D/M3E/M3F/M3G/M3H/M3I/M3J/M3K/M3L/M3M/M3N/M3O/M3P trials are references, not product acceptance or evidence of universal approach recall. No semantic trial is rerun or recertified by this structural gate; recorded evidence is not current inference. M3P selected-pair identity/component results are not warning recall, and incomplete Spring retrieval is not completed ground-truth evaluation.

review.method: agent visual review of source RGB proposals, blind to model outputs

review.scope: Not exhaustive per frame, not human review. Independent pose and LiDAR set relative-approach state, not the visual reviewer.

review.method: Agent visual review of ten RGB checkpoints before running any M3F inference. Corrected visible boxes; omitted ambiguous or heavily occluded objects.

review.method: Assistant visual review of all ten fixed checkpoint tiles, blind to M3G detector/candidate outputs. Visible 2D extents corrected from projected 3D boxes. Not independent human semantic adjudication.
review.limits: Selected targets only; not exhaustive scene annotation. Low-speed clip includes acceleration, crossing and overtaking. Dark/occluded riders and ambiguous projected targets explicitly omitted before inference; those omissions do not establish absence or safety.
